description: A rare inherited susceptibility to infection with specific human papillomaviruses, producing characteristic flat warty or pityriasis-versicolor-like lesions.
symptoms: Pigmented or hypopigmented patches may occur
causes: Inherited susceptibility to selected human papillomavirus infections
risk_factors: Ultraviolet exposure contributes to skin-cancer risk

appearance.general: Numerous flat-topped papules or patches resembling warts or pityriasis versicolor, often on sun-exposed skin.

warning_signs: New, enlarging, bleeding, or ulcerated lesions need prompt assessment because of increased skin-cancer risk.
prevention: Reduce ultraviolet exposure and use protective measures.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss lifelong surveillance of lesions and any suspicious changes.
